message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: The defendant Wang contracted a construction project, to settle payment he had someone help him to issue false VAT ordinary invoices (增值税普通发票) in the name of a company (某建筑五金有限公司) for amount 1,257,814.95 RMB, price 37,000 for the invoicing service. The invoice is counterfeit (虚开). This is a crime of "虚开发票罪" (Crime of issuing false invoices). Under Chinese criminal law, the offense is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" or "虚开普通发票罪". The statutory name: "虚开增值税普通发票罪". The rule: When listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "虚开增值税普通发票". Also need to consider if there is any other crime like "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" but not here; they used false invoice but not forging seal? The invoice is forged, but the crime is specifically "虚开增值税普通发票罪". The rule about forged seal is not applicable.

Thus single crime.
